title: Planet Orbitz, then Orbitz, LLC
lede: Screenshots of orbitz.com pages that the Internet Archive’s Wayback Machine saved, kept here as images. Click one to open the original capture. Most images on these pages were not saved, so they show as empty boxes.[^35]

snips.text: “Set gravity aside and prepare to embark on a tour into the bowels of the Orbiterium, where anything that matters is random and ultimately unintelligible.”
“This domain is currently registered by a member of myinternet.com”
“Soon the difference will be clear ©2000 Orbitz, LLC”
“Check out Orbitz' advanced search engine to search all airlines and over 2 billion fares in just seconds.”

note: The Wayback Machine holds other captures of orbitz.com; these five are the ones whose page text we checked.

captures.label: Orbiterium prelude
captures.title: The prelude to the Orbiterium
captures.text: The drink’s Planet Orbitz site opens with a prelude: set gravity aside and prepare for a tour of the Orbiterium, with a choice between a Netscape route and an Internet Explorer route.[^35]
captures.warn: Most images on this capture were not saved.

captures.label: Same prelude
captures.title: Still the drink’s site
captures.text: The same Orbiterium prelude, a year later.[^35]

captures.label: Placeholder
captures.title: A domain-service placeholder
captures.text: The page says the domain is currently registered by a member of myinternet.com. The drink’s site is gone.[^35]

captures.label: Orbitz, LLC
captures.title: ©2000 Orbitz, LLC
captures.text: The page says that soon the difference will be clear, beside a notice of ©2000 Orbitz, LLC, the name of the airline-backed travel venture.[^35][^14]
captures.warn: Every image on this capture shows as an empty box.

captures.label: Travel search
captures.title: A travel search preview
captures.text: The page advertises a search of all airlines and over 2 billion fares.[^35]
